doc_friction.issue: Started it in the background, then edited platform/ci/test_run_workflow_locally.py while it ran; its inspect.getsource test then read the edited file and failed (2 failures), which looked like a red main until a rerun after the edit passed 233/233. Worth noting: don't edit platform/ci while it runs.
No way to run one named step of a workflow (--only takes workflow names), so checking the one supersede-check step meant a full portfolio-validate run past the 100 s handoff (~5 min).

notes: Critique mode (backlog had only owner rows). friction_rank.py --live --ungated --days 3 plus run-record doc_friction; picked the run_workflow_locally report from session_01XpHqye3mm8o2YXnvRwxsJV: a local run left git user.email ci@example.com. Root cause: portfolio-validate.yml 'Supersede-check unit tests' runs git config --global, which locally writes the session's ~/.gitconfig. Fix: runner_files() adds GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL pointing at a per-process copy (XDG git/config + ~/.gitconfig, or an exported GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL) in RUNNER_TEMP. Verification: 3 new Execute tests (2 fail on the old runner); test_run_workflow_locally 233/233; full local portfolio-validate 100/100 run steps passed (10 not run: uses:/secret steps), Supersede-check ok (28 s), ~/.gitconfig md5 22bd8c2b... unchanged before/after and global user.email still the session's; promptctl validate ok; unittest discover -s prompts 136 OK; check_post_frontmatter and check_post_links ok. main_health: 255/256, the one FAIL was this run's own mid-run edit (see doc_friction). Left open: research-archive.yml's local-scope git config (job has contents: write, so the read-only screen skips it). No agent doc: the post and code comment carry it. Backlog ids touched: none.

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

human_equivalent.basis: diagnose a git identity leak in a CI runner, fix with tests, end-to-end check, short post

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
server-tool fees (web search is billed per search, not per token); the count is recorded, not priced
